en: Collected source inventories, response hashes and access results for PRWD and the province. Template pages and foreign water-district rate images are excluded from public guidance.
fil: Nakolekta ang inventory, response hash at access result ng PRWD at lalawigan. Hindi ginamit na gabay ang template pages at rate images ng ibang water district.

remaining.en: Confirm update dates and authority for individual records.
remaining.fil: Tiyakin ang petsa at awtoridad ng bawat rekord.

en: PRWD: 13 charter services, 20 tariff rows across four meter sizes, contact details and blank forms. Province: four source-listed hotlines, 15 office contacts and eight charter service references.
fil: PRWD: 13 serbisyo, 20 tariff row para sa apat na laki ng metro, contact at blank forms. Lalawigan: apat na hotline sa sanggunian, 15 office contact at walong serbisyo sa charter.

remaining.en: Verify hotline operation, current charter procedures, payment channels and broken forms. Municipal charter remains missing.
remaining.fil: Tiyakin ang hotline, kasalukuyang proseso, payment channel at sirang form. Kulang pa ang municipal charter.

en: Collected five PRWD board names, its creation reference and the province’s 13-page earthquake-drill ordinance document. These are separate from municipal elected officials and SB legislation.
fil: Nakolekta ang limang pangalan sa PRWD board, sanggunian ng paglikha at 13-pahinang dokumento ng earthquake-drill ordinance ng lalawigan. Hiwalay ito sa halal na opisyal at SB legislation ng munisipyo.

remaining.en: Board terms, full creating resolution, ordinance transcription and amendment checks.
remaining.fil: Mga termino ng board, buong creating resolution, transkripsyon at pagsusuri ng mga susog.

en: PRWD reports 12,520 concessionaires for December 2024. Archived connection and financial charts are retained. Utility connections are not population or household coverage.
fil: Iniulat ng PRWD ang 12,520 concessionaire noong Disyembre 2024. Naitala ang lumang connection at financial chart. Hindi populasyon o household coverage ang utility connections.

remaining.en: Pumping-station count conflicts, exact chart values and current operating statistics.
remaining.fil: Hindi nagtutugmang pumping-station count, eksaktong chart values at kasalukuyang estadistika.

en: PRWD: two procurement documents, three 2020–2021 financial charts and FOI reporting files. Province: 2025 annual budget, 2026 APP, six LGSF reports and 34 bid documents; six text-bearing bid pages name Pililla.
fil: PRWD: dalawang procurement document, tatlong financial chart noong 2020–2021 at FOI reports. Lalawigan: 2025 annual budget, 2026 APP, anim na LGSF report at 34 bid document; anim na bid page na may teksto ang tumutukoy sa Pililla.

remaining.en: 21 PRWD disclosure labels have no download. Review scans, bid conflicts, awards, delivery and payment. Municipal finance remains missing.
remaining.fil: Walang download ang 21 PRWD disclosure label. Suriin ang scans, bid conflicts, award, delivery at payment. Kulang pa ang municipal finance.

en: Collected 45 non-placeholder PRWD announcement pages and their linked images, plus Pililla entries in provincial tourism listings. Dated reading schedules and vacancies are archive evidence.
fil: Nakolekta ang 45 PRWD announcement page na walang placeholder at mga larawang naka-link dito, kasama ang Pililla sa tourism listings ng lalawigan. Archive evidence ang lumang reading schedule at vacancy.

remaining.en: Current advisories, visitor hours and access; a Pililla dining-list PDF returns 404.
remaining.fil: Kasalukuyang abiso, oras at access sa pagbisita; 404 ang Pililla dining-list PDF.
